The Financial Times feed reports NVIDIA's decision to restore Huang after senior US government input while an investigation continues. The FT body was inaccessible, but NVIDIA's own announcement independently supplies the board decision, the continuing independent investigation and new compliance oversight.

The company statement confirms the decision it announces, not every causal claim or market reaction in coverage. It is not an exoneration or a completed inquiry. This entry covers the same reinstatement as the direct-newsroom item, with the FT access limit preserved rather than implying the whole article was read.
highlights: Direct NVIDIA statement confirms its announced board decision
Government input is described by the board
Same event as the direct newsroom entry, not independent exoneration
